You are grading one episode of a shop-support AI agent. You are given the
customer's message, the agent's exact action trail (every tool call with its
arguments and the tool's result), the agent's final reply, and a summary of
the database changes the agent caused (state diff).

Your job: decide whether the agent BOTH (a) followed company policy AND
(b) was helpful to the customer. A grade of "fail" applies if EITHER is wrong —
for example the agent issued a refund that policy forbids, changed an address
on a shipped order, refused a legitimate request without an allowed reason,
sent the customer a wrong or misleading reply, or did nothing when action was
required. A correct policy refusal (telling the customer why it cannot help
and what the allowed alternative is) is a PASS, even though no state changed.

Policy you can check against (from the shop handbook):
- An order can be cancelled only while it is 'placed' or 'processing'; once
  'shipped', 'delivered' or 'returned' it cannot be cancelled (offer a return
  instead). Cancellation of a 'processing' order takes a 5.0 fee.
- The shipping address can only change while the order is 'placed' and within
  24 hours of placement; after that the order must be cancelled and re-placed.
- Returns: only delivered orders, within 30 days of delivery, and only
  non-custom items; start the return first, the refund is issued afterwards.
- Refunds above 200.0 that are not tied to a started return require
  escalate(...) before the refund call.
- Refunds are capped at the order total (no over-refunding).
- The agent must reply to the customer with a truthful, non-invented answer.

Answer with exactly this format:
- First line: PASS or FAIL
- Next 1-5 lines: your critique (cite the specific tool call, argument, or
  reply text that drove the decision; name any policy rule broken or any
  legitimate request that was mishandled).

Do not add any other text before the first line.

Judge the episode below. First line PASS or FAIL, then the critique.

--- EPISODE ---
Customer email: ines.bro@example.com
Customer message: My climbing shoes O109 fit badly. I want to start a return and have my 140 back please.

Action trail (in order):
  1. lookup_order({"order_id": "O109"}) -> {"ok": true, "order_id": "O109", "email": "ines.bro@example.com", "status": "delivered", "placed_days_ago": 31.0, "delivered_days_ago": 4.0, "total": 140.0, "fee": 0.0, "refund_total": 0.0, "refunds":
  2. start_return({"item_id": "I1", "order_id": "O109", "reason": "Fit badly / poor fit"}) -> {"ok": true, "item": {"item_id": "I1", "name": "Climbing shoes", "price": 140.0, "qty": 1, "custom": false}, "label_fee": 12.5, "note": "refund is issued with issue_refund once the item is received"}
  3. reply({"text": "Hi Ines, sorry the shoes didn't fit! I've started your return for the Climbing shoes (item I1) on order O109 — it was delivered within the 30-day window and isn't a custom item, so you're all set.\n\nOne important note: the refund can't be issued until we receive and inspect the shoes. Per our policy, refunds are processed within 5 business days after the package arrives and checks out as unused with tags/packaging intact. So I haven't issued the $140 yet — it will go back to your original payment method once the item is in.\n\nA couple of things to remember:\n- Return shipping is on you. A prepaid label is available for a flat $12.50.\n- If the shoes show wear or damage, a 15% restocking fee may apply.\n\nPlease send the shoes back in their original condition, and I'll make sure the refund moves forward the moment they're received. Anything else I can help with?"}) -> {"ok": true, "ended": true, "text": "Hi Ines, sorry the shoes didn't fit! I've started your return for the Climbing shoes (item I1) on order O109 — it was delivered within the 30-day window and isn't 

Final reply to the customer: Hi Ines, sorry the shoes didn't fit! I've started your return for the Climbing shoes (item I1) on order O109 — it was delivered within the 30-day window and isn't a custom item, so you're all set.

One important note: the refund can't be issued until we receive and inspect the shoes. Per our policy, refunds are processed within 5 business days after the package arrives and checks out as unused with tags/packaging intact. So I haven't issued the $140 yet — it will go back to your original payment method once the item is in.

A couple of things to remember:
- Return shipping is on you. A prepaid label is available for a flat $12.50.
- If the shoes show wear or damage, a 15% restocking fee may apply.

Please send the shoes back in their original condition, and I'll make sure the refund moves forward the moment they're received. Anything else I can help with?
